ad-fontes-1.title: The Five Solas of the Reformation
ad-fontes-1.description: An issue devoted to the foundations of the Protestant Reformation, explaining the five essential principles that underlie biblical Christian faith. An introductory resource for a clear understanding of the gospel.

ad-fontes-2.title: Raising Children
ad-fontes-2.description: A practical resource addressing the Christian responsibility of raising children biblically, offering clear principles for their spiritual formation.

ad-fontes-3.title: 1700 Years Since the Council of Nicaea
ad-fontes-3.description: A theological and historical study of one of the most important moments in the history of Christianity, highlighting its relevance for the faith today.

ad-fontes-4.title: The Danger of the Charismatic Movement
ad-fontes-4.description: An issue that critically examines the influence of the charismatic movement and offers a biblical perspective on doctrinal discernment.

book-cinci-puncte.title: Five Points
book-cinci-puncte.description: Grace is God's way of doing you good when you do not deserve it at all. But do we truly know how undeserved grace is? Only God can reveal this to us. He does so through the Bible. And when He does, the wonders of His grace shine forth with breathtaking brilliance. These Five Points deal with how Christians come into being and how they are kept forever by the grace of God. (Romanian edition.)

book-sex-lume.title: Sex in a Broken World
book-sex-lume.description: We live in a deeply broken world... but there is hope. Sexuality is a fundamental part of what it means to be human, part of God's beautiful design when He created all things. And yet sex in our world today looks nothing like what God intended it to be. Sexual brokenness surrounds us and, in one way or another, affects us all. This sexual brokenness reveals our deep need for redemption... (Romanian edition.)

book-sola-scriptura.title: Sola Scriptura
book-sola-scriptura.description: A work devoted to defending and explaining the authority and sufficiency of Scripture in the contemporary context. The book addresses modern challenges to the doctrine of Sola Scriptura and provides a solid biblical foundation. (Romanian edition.)

book-reformarea-bisericii.title: The Reformation of the Church
book-reformarea-bisericii.description: A historical and theological study of the church's ongoing need for reformation according to Scripture. The book draws out lessons from the past that bear on the doctrinal health of the church today. (Romanian edition.)

book-harul-definit.title: Grace Defined and Defended
book-harul-definit.description: A clear and biblical presentation of the doctrine of grace, emphasizing both its definition and its defense against erroneous interpretations. The book helps toward a right understanding of salvation by grace. (Romanian edition.)
